params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal 3D render, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows), premium boutique interior at night. A row of seven identical glowing display windows receding into the distance in perspective, each lit warm yellow (#FDD506) from inside, reflections on the polished dark floor, thin haze and golden dust. Each showcase displays beauty-master products neatly arranged on glass shelves: elegant cosmetic bottles and serum droppers, nail polish bottles in a row, professional makeup brushes in a holder, lash and brow tools, a hair styling iron, skincare jars and tubes — the same product set repeated in every window, smaller and smaller into the depth. Upper 35% of the frame nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm, 'one showcase repeated seven times' mood.
